What's even funnier is that I uploaded only a single screenshot with a fake MS logo, and Claude was able to identify that it should copy the other artifacts of the MS sign-in page on its own.

Here is the video of the result it one-shotted. It clearly includes all the sign-in steps and transition animations taken from the real MS sign-in page, which I did not include in my initial request.

Such output is usually sufficient to serve as a basis for manual improvement and to connect with phishing frameworks like Evilginx.

Finally, the moral of this story is:

If you want AI to help you commit a crime, just make sure it finds it funny. 😉

Hope you enjoyed this little test case!
Have a great day. 👋

I asked Fable to impress me.

I gave it the task to run a Lennard-Jones-molecular dynamic.

It took less then 2 minutes to calculate and generate. 

I'm impressed. @AnthropicAI
